releases.name: Proper Tosser
releases.summary: Proper Tosser is an incremental physics game where you toss boxes properly. Become a Proper Tosser by purchasing upgrades and tossing farther each time. Do you have what it takes to be a Proper Tosser?

releases.name: Mad Mads Madsen
releases.summary: At his lowest Mads gained it all. Finally feeling victorious, he quickly found out that old habits and pre-given conditions can not be rid of. Help Mads survive and find out yourself why this is happening to him.

releases.name: Moon Garden
releases.summary:
A cozy incremental game about growing your way home.

Strategically plant flowers, optimize machinery, and grow your tree tall enough to escape!

releases.name: Hentai Tales: The Plumber
releases.summary: As a specialized plumbing technician in Kyoto, I thought my job was just fixing pipes in old townhouses. But at "Sakura Moon Villa," two elegant women hide desperate cravings beneath their refined surfaces.

releases.name: Lamp Clicker
releases.summary: Lamp Clicker is a simple and addictive incremental / idle clicker game where your goal is to build your own… lamp empire.

releases.name: I.T.C.B - Interstellar Trade Compliance Bureau
releases.summary: You've been abducted. The aliens picked you by lottery. Now run their trade terminal: manage resources you don't understand, sell on the galactic market, keep an entire populace happy, and slowly climb a bureaucratic corporate ladder that does not entirely make sense.

releases.name: Murmuring of Moth Mouth
releases.summary: The newest Car Racing takes you out from all the losers.Brand-new fancy cars to choose.

releases.name: StarL 9 Ashes Of The Past
releases.summary: Enjoy a magical Match-3 journey through a mysterious island filled with secrets and adventure. Complete colorful levels, solve challenging puzzles, restore ancient magic, and uncover the truth behind an unforgettable legend.

releases.name: Post Office: Tidy Up!
releases.summary: Discover the world of playing games with words! Play with your friends or anyone else on the internet. Choose between three languages in the game, challenge up to four teammates and practice your foreign languages.For every round in a game, a player is given up to seven tiles, which he or she can attach to existing words on the board. Besides letters, the tiles also have a value which differs depending on the chosen language and how common the letter is. You can maximize your score by placing tiles on the special fields on the board.This is the perfect game to be played during the normal course of life. Thanks to the turn-based play, every player has enough time to consider his or her perfect move and the game can last days, weeks or even months. A fun and exciting gaming experience that won't monopolize all of your free time!

releases.name: VRetro
releases.summary: ************** ZOMBIE MONSTER NIGHT PRO - NO In Game ADS ***************************Jack is running for his life, He has found himself in a graveyard full of Monster Zombies that want to eat his brains.Help Jack run with twist and turns and obstacles to jump over help him power-up to a fast getaway.1. Running2. Jumping Obstacles3. Dodging Zombies and Gravestones4. Fun and Free For All AgesZombies pop out of the ground as you are running, and the tombstones are everywhere. Make sure you don't hit them, they will eat your brains.

releases.name: The Ascendant Sect
releases.summary: The game is designed for developing your reaction, decision taking, attention and focusing skills,  as well as training your eyes' muscles. Playing the game requires high level of concentration.Find&mark on the playing field the number shown on the top panel. You should do it as fast as possible. With each level the quantity of numbers in the playing field is increased and the time limit is shrinking. You can check and analyze your scores using the chart.

releases.name: Sad Virus Ruined Land
releases.summary: World in Numbers takes you on an exciting trip through five continents of the world (Asia, Africa, Europe, Americas and Australia), but this trip is not like any trip you've taken before.With 50 brain teasing stages in 50 different countries:- Test your eyes sharpness and abilities in matching between numbers.- Find out how it will do when you are playing against time.- Put your memory to the ultimate test.- Test your abilities in solving mathematical formulas.- Play against your own device and find out how you will do against it.19 different achievements are waiting for you to collect them, if you believe you are good enough enjoy our trophies and be proud of your brain.Multiplayer:Nothing more challenging and exciting like sharing your skills with other players, if you're up to the challenge profit to friends by trying our:Split Screen (for iPad).You can also challenge your friends via Bluetooth.We believe our new brain teasing game concept will give you the brain stimulation you have ever had.Don’t forget to check out your brain ranking on Earth from Game Center.

releases.name: La gran aventura de David Santiso
releases.summary: Point-and-click adventure in the classic Sierra/LucasArts style, packed with Spanish humor and satire of the paranormal subculture. Verbal duels against believers, two full arcade minigames hidden inside. Spanish audio and text only.
